claim: If additional requests for the same object (with the same cache key) arrive at an edge location before CloudFront receives the response to the first request, CloudFront pauses before forwarding them to the origin, which reduces the load on the origin, and then sends the response from the original request to all the requests that it received while it was paused.

evidence.quote: This brief pause helps to reduce the load on the origin. CloudFront sends the response from the original request to all the requests that it received while it was paused.

However, if there are simultaneous requests for the same object—that is, if additional requests for the same object (with the same cache key) arrive at the edge location before CloudFront receives the response to the first request—CloudFront pauses before forwarding the additional requests to the origin.
